Prevent transactions below the range start from being treated as owned and dropping out on reload
Speed up imports with high range starts and prevent pathological inputs from stalling the node
reviewability: Ready for review with no known blockers
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified consistency across reload and confirmed performance gains on regtest (fametrano)
Verified tests fail without the fix and pass with it after suggestions were addressed (cprkrn)
